title: Project Starlight and the 2001 National Press Club event

tellings.quote: It was called Project Starlight code name. We were private and then it went public in 01 with the National Press Club that had 800 million people see it.

plain: A UFO activist named Steven Greer says he ran a private effort, code-named Project Starlight, starting in the early 1990s. He says it went public in 2001 with an event at the National Press Club in Washington, which he says "800 million people" saw. Greer tells it as his own work, and if he is right, his campaign for official disclosure of UFO secrets reached a huge audience.
